svg.desc: OSIRIS PHOTONFORGE: question, observables, model and validation. Proposed design; no measured results.
svg.text: Can physically constrained joint estimation of transfer smear and detector background reduce
scene-dependent artifacts while preserving measured radiance and color ratios?
Raw and calibrated images, camera/filter metadata, exposure and temperature, calibration
